sloka: यम् तु पश्यसि तिष्ठन्तम् प्रभिन्नम् इव कुन्जरम् ।यो बलात् क्षोभयेत् क्रुद्धः समुद्रम् अपि वानरः ॥६-२८-८॥।।
transliteration: yam tu paśyasi tiṣṭhantam prabhinnam iva kunjaram ।yo balāt kṣobhayet kruddhaḥ samudram api vānaraḥ ॥6-28-8॥।।

translations.english: "O Lord! You may see the one standing there like an elephant who can churn up the sea when he is angry. He has come to Lanka earlier, seen Sita and gone back. You may see that he has come again."
